material: Super duplex stainless steel casing/impeller, rubber-lined CS column (wet pit)
remarks: Rated 19,000 m3/h (half of 38,000 m3/h design flow, DEC-EPCE-0002; HMB streams 25/26 give 10,197 kg/s = 36,050 m3/h per IG-04, +5.4 % margin) x 17 m (AL-12 head 16 m +6 %) / 0.86 = 1,041 kW shaft, /0.96 = 1,084 kW, so 1,120 kW.
